description: This PHP file defines a custom view class 'AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewDetail' for handling PDF template details within SuiteCRM. It extends the existing 'ViewDetail' class, overriding the display method to decode HTML entities in certain bean fields before rendering.
external_files: PHP internal function for decoding HTML entities

classes.name: AOS_PDF_TemplatesViewDetail
classes.description: A custom view class for detailed PDF template display with HTML decoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to decode HTML entities in certain bean fields before calling the parent display method.

methods.name: setDecodeHTML
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities and replaces non-breaking spaces in the 'pdfheader', 'description', and 'pdffooter' fields of the bean.
